extra_vocab.zh: 有望的人選、潛在客戶；前景、可能性
extra_vocab.en: someone who may be hired or may buy; also the chance of something good in the future
extra_vocab.note: 文章裡實際出現的是形容詞 prospective（prospective employees＝可能錄用的應徵者）。prospect 是同詞幹的名詞，指「有可能被錄用或成交的人」，也可指「前景」。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 表示「前景、可能性」時常用 the prospect of + N／V-ing，of 後面接 V-ing，不接原形動詞（the prospect of working abroad）。

example.en: Job prospects in the logistics sector look better this year.
example.zh: 今年物流業的就業前景看起來比較好。

example.en: Strong career prospects attract many graduates to the logistics industry.
example.zh: 良好的職涯前景吸引許多畢業生投入物流業。

example.en: The prospect of working abroad excited most of the new staff.
example.zh: 到國外工作的可能性讓多數新員工很興奮。

example.en: Our team contacts every sales prospect on the list this week.
example.zh: 我們團隊本週會聯絡名單上的每位潛在客戶。

examples.en: She is an excellent prospect for the software engineer position.
examples.zh: 她是軟體工程師職位的絕佳人選。

examples.en: Each prospect receives a follow-up call within two days.
examples.zh: 每位潛在客戶兩天內都會接到後續電話。

examples.en: There is a strong prospect that sales will double next year.
examples.zh: 明年銷售額很有可能會成長一倍。

confusable.diff: prospective 是形容詞，指「未來可能的、潛在的」；prospect 是名詞，指人選或前景。
confusable.usage: prospect 是名詞；prospective 是形容詞，放在名詞前，如 prospective clients。

example.en: We invited prospective clients to a product demonstration.
example.zh: 我們邀請潛在客戶參加產品展示。

confusable.diff: perspective 是「看事情的角度」，拼法和發音都與 prospect 很像，但意思不同。

example.en: Please share your perspective on the new schedule.
example.zh: 請分享你對新時程的看法。

similar.diff: candidate 是正式被考慮的應徵者；prospect 還在「可能」階段，也能指潛在客戶。

example.en: Every candidate must complete a short test before the interview.
example.zh: 每位應徵者面試前都要完成一份簡短測驗。

similar.diff: lead 是業務上的銷售線索，可能是人或公司；prospect 通常指一個具體的潛在客戶。

example.en: The trade show gave us fifty new leads for the product.
example.zh: 這次展覽為產品帶來了五十個新的銷售線索。

similar.diff: outlook 指整體趨勢的預測；prospect 常指個人或公司將來的機會。

example.en: The economic outlook for the next quarter is positive.
example.zh: 下一季的經濟展望是正面的。

example.en: Each applicant must submit a resume and a cover letter.
example.zh: 每位應徵者都必須繳交履歷和求職信。

example.en: The client asked us to reschedule the meeting.
example.zh: 客戶要求我們重新安排會議時間。

example.en: The new market has great potential for our products.
example.zh: 這個新市場對我們的產品有很大的潛力。

example.en: This project is a good opportunity to meet new partners.
example.zh: 這個專案是認識新夥伴的好機會。

derived.link: prospect + -ive，形容詞字尾，像 active、creative；表示「將來可能成為…的」

example.en: The manager reviewed every prospect before choosing the final group.
example.zh: 經理在選出最終名單前審視了每位人選。

example.en: Our sales team prospects for new clients at trade shows.
example.zh: 我們的業務團隊在展覽中尋找新客戶。

senses.en: a person who may be hired or may buy something

example.en: He is a strong prospect for the new sales manager role.
example.zh: 他是新任業務經理職位的有力人選。

senses.en: the chance of success in the future
senses.distinguish: 後面常接 of 或前面有 career、job 等字，談的是未來的機會。

example.en: The company's growth prospects improved after the merger.
example.zh: 合併後，公司的成長前景變好了。

senses.en: something that may happen in the future
senses.distinguish: 多用 the prospect of + V-ing，談的是預期會發生的事，常帶感受。

example.en: Employees were worried about the prospect of losing their jobs.
